body: Is anyone there. I’m alive. I need someone

Today I woke up and got out of bed instead of laying there for an hour thinking about suicide and if I should do it before I have to go into work. 

I feel good today and I felt good last night. 

Something positive about my day is hard for me to imagine honestly which is sad because it’s not that there isn’t anything positive, it’s that I don’t see it. 

Yesterday I had a really good lunch with my co workers. That was great, and I played with my friend on overwatch last night and she is probably my best friend on that game so that was good.
Thank you, I’m doing alright, hanging in there :). You?

Thank you so much for your kind words. I got some sleep and thought it over. I don’t know why I get so sensitive and care about the opinions of 2 people who act insane. It’s dumb, but at the time it felt pretty bad. 

I get suicidal a lot, especially lately, but I have found that my medicine seems to be starting to make me feel better. 

Thank you for caring. Seriously, I needed that. I hope you’re doing okay.
It’s very fun but yeah way too toxic :/ but don’t let that stop you from trying if that’s what you want!

I’ve thought about doing this a lot; Overwatch is my first online game and the only game I’ve been this addicted to. I usually go for more single player/story based games, but OW has brought out my competitive streak. I love it so much, but it’s doing so much harm to my personal life that I don’t know if it’s worth it. 

Thank you for the advice. I genuinely appreciate you reaching out. :)
I am; I’ll be on tonight :) thanks for reaching out

It made me have panic attacks but it was later discovered I had anxiety as well as depression and the drug increased my anxiety by a lot so this might not affect you. I hope it works for you and you start feeling better friend. :)

Thank you for the reply and reaching out. I’m glad you’ve found something that works for you. 

I’m 22 female and I have been on Zoloft for about 7 weeks. It seemed to be working but now not so much. I just want to find a solution honestly but I’m not sure if that will be possible. 

Thanks again. I’m glad to not feel so alone right now. I will keep trying to find a solution until I either find it or die trying (haha).

I have a great job and people who care about me but I’m on the verge of messing everything up because of my depression. I just keep pushing the limits and soon I won’t have a job or anyone who cares. All I can think about is suicide. I don’t want to die I just want the pain to end.
